name: Peter
overview: Peter, originally named Simon and also called Cephas, was a fisherman called by Jesus to become a fisher of men, as seen when Jesus invited him to follow Him and immediately left his nets (Matthew 4:18-20). Scripture highlights Peter's close relationship with Jesus, including Jesus healing Peter's mother-in-law in his home (Matthew 8:14) and Peter's prominent role among the twelve apostles (Matthew 10:2). His faith is exemplified in moments like boldly stepping out onto the water at Jesus' invitation (Matthew 14:28), demonstrating both his devotion and human frailty.
